name: c64-test-debugger
description: Step-debug compiled 6502 unit tests (breakpoints, step, locals) via the repo's TestDebugger CLI engine.

commands.title: C64 Test Debugger: Debug Test at Cursor
C64 Test Debugger: Debug All Tests

testSelector.description: TestClass.TestMethod[:N] to run. If omitted, resolved from the class/method enclosing the cursor in the active editor.

configurationSnippets.label: C64 Test Debugger: Launch
configurationSnippets.description: Debug a compiled unit test in SimpleEmulator

configurationSnippets.label: C64 Test Debugger: Launch (all tests)
configurationSnippets.description: Run every test in turn, stopping wherever a breakpoint fires in whichever test hits it

program.description: Project to build and run: Demo, Hunchback or C64Presentation. If omitted, taken from the project folder of the active editor (default Demo).

viceExe.description: Path to x64sc.exe. Defaults to the VICE_EXE environment variable, then c:\tools\VICE\bin\x64sc.exe.

configurationSnippets.label: C64 on VICE: Launch
configurationSnippets.description: Build a debug copy of a C64 program, run it on VICE and stop at breakpoints
